role: The singleton ClippingHelper: init() reads the GL projection and modelview matrices, multiplies them into clippingMatrix, derives and normalizes the six frustum planes from it.
scope_reason: Matrix plumbing for the frustum test; the native renderer reads its projection and modelview from renderstate and applies them directly.

notes: This file exists to feed GL state into the frustum; the native engine's matrices are computed in renderstate.c renderstate_compute (matching EntityRenderer's own matrix code, not glGetFloat). Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): GL plumbing: GL is the numerical oracle, not emitted (SPEC); atlases and meshes are consumed as data.
